Answer with status, value, quotes and section.

answer.value: Partial: SFT data comes from three sources: reused InternVL3 instruction-following data; multimodal "Thinking"-mode reasoning data synthesized by having InternVL3-78B describe images and DeepSeek-R1 sample reasoning rollouts, with incorrect-final-answer rollouts filtered out; and capability-expansion datasets (GUI-based interaction, embodied interaction, etc.). Pre-training uses large-scale text and multimodal corpora. The card does not state how rights were obtained.
quotes: (1) Instruction-following data from InternVL3, which are reused to preserve broad coverage of vision–language tasks.

To construct such data, we first use InternVL3-78B to describe the image and then input the description into DeepSeek-R1 to sample rollouts with detailed reasoning processes. Rollouts with an incorrect final answer are filtered out.
(3) Capability-expansion datasets, which endow InternVL3.5 with new skills, including GUI-based interaction, embodied interaction, and scalable vect
During the pre-training stage, we update all model parameters jointly using the combination of large-scale text and multimodal corpora.
